Es wird eine thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation des herbiziden Wirkstoffs 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl) cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione) beschrieben. Diese thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation weist besondere Vorteile in der Stabilität von Suspensionformulierungen auf.
Die Schmelzpunkte wurden mittels DSC (Pyris 1 der Fa. Perkin Elmer, Heizrate 10 K min-1ermittelt.
notes: This row carries no compound. Paragraph [0019] was read in full, in German, and genuinely names none. Everything named in it is an instrument, a maker, a method or a program: DSC on a Pyris 1 from Perkin Elmer at 10 K min-1, FT-Raman on an RFS 100/S from Bruker at 128 scans, infrared on a Bruker Tensor 37 at 64 scans, solid density by method SOP 5024 on an Ultrapyknometer 1000 T from Quanta-Chrome or from the single-crystal analysis, single-crystal work on an M18X-HF rotating anode from MACScience with a SMART-CCD-1000 detector from Bruker-AXS, and the programs SAINT-NT V 5.0, SADABS and SHELXTL NT V5.1. MoKalpha is the radiation, not a substance. The paragraph pairs no value with any compound, so the density and melting point methods it describes were not attached to a compound record here; the melting points themselves are printed in paragraphs [0010] to [0012], outside this section. The file is present and empty on purpose: this section was read, and it names nothing.

Ein Gegenstand der Erfindung ist daher eine in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierende Modifikation von 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione). / Im Rahmen der vorliegenden Erfindung wurde festgestellt, dass Tembotrione außer der in einem orthorhombischen System kristallisierenden stabilen Modifikation auch in mindestens zwei metastabilen Modifikationen auftritt.

Die stabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 124,0°C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 1) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 1a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation I bezeichnet.

Die eine metastabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 123,9°C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 2) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 2a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation II bezeichnet.

Die zweite metastabile Modifikation hat einen Schmelzpunkt von 121,6 °C, ein charakteristisches Raman-Spektrum (Abb. 3) und ein charakteristisches Infrarot-Spektrum (Abb. 3a). Sie wird nachfolgend als Kristallmodifikation III bezeichnet.

notes: Caption at 472, carrying a stray [0018] marker from the OCR, and the German data lines at 475 to 486 plus the continuation row at 508. Lines 487 to 501 and 509 to 512 are the EN convenience rendering of the same values. Table 5 (X-ray powder diffractometry of crystal modification I, lines 472-512) and Table 6 (crystal modification II, lines 513-544) print the same 49 values of 2 theta in the same order, 7.3765 through 36.7974, and claim 5 recites the same list. This was checked value by value against the source. Two polymorphs cannot share one powder pattern, and distinguishing them is what the patent is for. The reading that one of the two captions might name the wrong modification is ruled out by the patent's own Table 7 at lines 545 to 562, which gives modification I as orthorhombic (printed orthorhombisch), space group Pna21, cell volume 1788,91(18) Å3 and modification II as monoclinic (printed monoklin), space group P2(1)/n, cell volume 1814,21(10) Å3: two different crystal systems, with different space groups, different unit cell axes and different cell volumes, cannot produce one diffraction pattern, so no reading of the captions makes both tables correct. What remains is a duplication in the published patent whose direction the document does not reveal: nothing in it says which of the two tables holds the real measurement, and the powder pattern of crystal modification II is therefore not disclosed anywhere in this document. That is not decided here, neither table is corrected and neither is dropped, and each record keeps the attribution its own caption gives. This is a defect in the published patent, not in the transcription. Claim 5 at line 755, dependent on claim 1, which claims the modification crystallising in an orthorhombic system, recites the same 49 values in the same order; verified cell by cell against both tables. This does not settle which table holds the real measurement, since a duplication can be carried into a claim as easily as into a table, and it is recorded as evidence rather than as a resolution. The caption names Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione (crystal modification I of tembotrione). That one phrase carries two records here: the modification, whose canonical alias is the whole phrase, and tembotrione itself, which the same German words name. Rule 1 extracts every compound named, and the rest of this run emits both off the identical construction.
